figures.name: Indra (Thai)

ability.name: Tavatimsa Gate
ability.description: Open the gates of the 33 heavens, granting all allied deities +2 to all stats for 1 turn.

figures.description: The king of the Tavatimsa heaven in Thai cosmology, patron of warriors and kings, depicted riding the three-headed elephant Erawan.

figures.name: Erawan

ability.name: Triple Blessing
ability.description: Three heads each bless a different allied card: +3 power, +3 defense, or +3 magic.

figures.description: The divine three-headed white elephant mount of Indra in Thai mythology, symbol of royal power and cosmic order.

figures.name: Nang Kwak

ability.name: Merchant's Blessing
ability.description: Double the gold yield of all allied commerce-domain cards this turn.

figures.description: The Thai spirit of good fortune and prosperity, depicted with a raised right hand welcoming customers and wealth into the home.

figures.name: Phra Phirun

ability.name: Monsoon Call
ability.description: Force opponent to discard a card and draw one; gain 3 water tokens usable as mana.

figures.description: The Thai rain deity, essential for the rice-farming culture, invoked before each planting season.

figures.name: Mae Thorani

ability.name: Wringing the Earth
ability.description: Wring water from her hair to flood the battlefield, reducing all enemy stats by 2 for 2 turns.

figures.description: The earth goddess who witnessed the Buddha's enlightenment, wringing torrents from her hair to sweep away Mara's demonic army.

figures.name: Yak (Giant Guardian)

ability.name: Temple Warden
ability.description: Prevent the next attack against any allied card; the blocked damage is reflected at half value.

figures.description: The giant yaksha guardian figures that protect Thai Buddhist temples, fierce in appearance but devoted protectors of sacred spaces.

figures.name: Kinnari

ability.name: Celestial Song
ability.description: Heal all allied cards for 3 HP and remove one debuff from each.

figures.description: The half-human half-bird celestial beings of Thai mythology, gifted with beautiful voices and graceful dance, symbols of faithful love.

figures.name: Naga (Thai)

ability.name: Naga Blessing
ability.description: Create a protective ward on an allied card; first damage dealt to it this turn is absorbed.

figures.description: The great serpent beings who protect Buddhist temples in Thailand, often depicted lining temple staircases as guardian rails.

figures.name: Suvannamaccha

ability.name: Golden Fish Tail
ability.description: Steal one item or resource from the opponent and add it to your hand.

figures.description: The golden mermaid daughter of Ravana who tried to sabotage the monkey army's bridge construction, but fell in love with Hanuman.

figures.name: Phra Narai (Thai Vishnu)

ability.name: Chakra of Order
ability.description: Deal 8 damage to one enemy and reduce their power by 3 permanently.

figures.description: Vishnu as worshipped in Thai royal tradition, the cosmic preserver who incarnates to restore balance, closely linked with Thai kingship.

figures.name: Wessuwan

ability.name: Giant Army
ability.description: Summon two Yak guardians with 7/7/4/5/4 stats to protect your field.

figures.description: The king of the giant yakshas and lord of the northern quarter in Thai Buddhist cosmology, guardian of treasures and patron of wealth.

figures.name: Mara (Thai)

ability.name: Army of Illusions
ability.description: Create three illusion copies of a target card; they have half stats but fight for you.

figures.description: The tempter deity who tried to prevent the Buddha's enlightenment, commanding vast armies of demons and illusions.

figures.name: Phi Krasue

ability.name: Hungry Float
ability.description: Drain 4 life from target enemy card and heal self by same amount.

figures.description: A terrifying Thai ghost appearing as a floating female head with glowing entrails, said to prey on the vulnerable at night.

figures.name: Phi Phop

ability.name: Body Snatcher
ability.description: Possess one enemy card, flipping it to fight for you for 1 turn.

figures.description: A Thai spirit that possesses people and causes illness, one of the most feared phi in the Thai spirit hierarchy.

figures.name: Suriyaphob

ability.name: Solar Blade
ability.description: Deal 7 damage to one enemy; if they are dark-aligned, deal 10 instead.

figures.description: A great hero of Thai epic tradition, champion of righteousness who battles the forces of darkness on behalf of the gods.

figures.name: Hanuman (Thai)

ability.name: Diamond Body
ability.description: Become invulnerable to all attacks for 1 turn; counterattack deals double damage.

figures.description: The Thai version of the monkey warrior hero, depicted with a crystal-like body and often serving as a romantic figure alongside his battle prowess.

figures.name: Tosakan (Ravana)

ability.name: Ten-Headed Roar
ability.description: All enemies lose 3 stats across the board; Tosakan gains those stats temporarily.

figures.description: The ten-headed demon king from the Thai Ramakien epic, sorcerer and warrior of immense power who abducts the princess Sida.

figures.name: Pho Khun Ramkhamhaeng

ability.name: Law of the Land
ability.description: Establish a rule: for 2 turns, all cards must follow a chosen stat restriction or be discarded.

figures.description: The legendary Thai king credited with creating the Thai alphabet and establishing a golden age of justice and prosperity.

figures.name: Benjakai

ability.name: False Form
ability.description: Transform into a copy of any card on the field for 2 turns, inheriting their abilities.

figures.description: A female demon general of Tosakan who disguises herself to infiltrate the monkey army, a shapeshifter of great cunning.

figures.name: Garuda (Thai)

ability.name: Naga Strike
ability.description: Deal 9 damage to any water or serpent-type enemy; become the royal emblem card.

figures.description: The divine eagle-man who is the mount of Phra Narai, emblazoned on the Thai royal coat of arms, sworn enemy of the nagas.
